description_en: Deletes a specified ssh key for the current user
description_zh: 为当前用户删除指定的SSH密钥
name: DeleteUserKey

parameters.help_en: The ID of the organization. You can find the organization ID in the URL of the organization page on Alibaba Cloud DevOps. For example, in `https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{organizationId}`, `{organizationId}` is the organization ID
parameters.help_zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
parameters.name: organization_id

parameters.help_en: The personal access token. This parameter is not required if you use an AccessKey pair or STS temporary authorization for authentication
parameters.help_zh:
个人访问令牌。 
使用阿里云AK+SK或使用STS临时授权方式不需要传该字段
parameters.name: access_token

parameters.help_en: The unique ID of the ssh key
parameters.name: key_id
